A PSU Fault that comes back soon after every restart, on a unit that already had its power supply replaced, needs a proper review for a replacement. I've sent that review to the team. When you reply, please tell me whether the power supply plugged in now is the new one we sent in October. That will help them decide faster.

Sarah

Hi Eric,

You're right, and I'm sorry. The B30 should have been with you weeks ago. This NerdOctaxe has failed twice, after the original you sent back in May, and you've had to chase us over and over.

The B30 has now left our Tennessee warehouse, with the Power K. in the same box. Your tracking number is (number hidden), and you can follow it here: (tracking link hidden)

The NerdOctaxe return is approved, and you don't need to send any more videos. A PSU Fault that comes back even on the new power supply points to a fault on the miner's board, not the power supply. Your prepaid USPS label is here: ····

Please print it, tape it to the box and write Shop···· clearly on the outside. You only need to send back the miner itself.

The NerdOctaxe is out of stock with no restock date, so I can't send you the same model again. The closest unit we have on the shelf is the Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s), which ships within 2 business days. I've asked the team to approve it as your replacement at no cost. They pick that up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer will come to this email. If you'd prefer something else, just reply and tell me. Your replacement ships as soon as your returned unit reaches our warehouse.

Sarah

Hi Eric,

Thanks for the video and for confirming the new power supply. If the power supply looks normal and the miner still shows PSU Fault and makes that sound, the fault is in the miner itself. The return we've already set up covers that. Your prepaid label and the Shop···· reference from my last email are still the way to send it back.

You're right about the Thor P2. It does 10 TH/s and the NerdOctaxe does 12, so it's a step down in hashrate. It's still the closest match we have on the shelf today. The NerdOctaxe has no stock and no restock date. Among the Bitcoin miners in stock, everything else is smaller: the BC04 does 6 TH/s and the LV08 does 4.2 TH/s.

If you want more hashrate, the step up is the Bitfortun BS-4 at 18 TH/s. That's a pre-order that ships from the manufacturer by November 30, and it lists at $599.99. It costs more than your NerdOctaxe, so you'd pay the difference. If you're interested, tell me and I'll get you the exact figure.

Your Thor P2 replacement is already set up and reserved for you. It ships as soon as your NerdOctaxe arrives at our warehouse, so the quickest way to get it is to drop the box off with the label. Just let me know if you'd like the Thor P2 or the BS-4.

Sarah
